posts.text:
I just shipped this to MailCheap.AI:

👀 Write with your team & see their cursors live
🌙 Dark mode for every theme
✍️ Write welcome, confirmation & last-chance emails in the editor
🤖 Your AI agent adds the signup form to your site
📊 Google Analytics, Tag Manager & Meta pixel on your website
📅 Pick any period for your overview
🌐 Edit an issue's web page, even once it's sent
📈 Page views, day by day

👀 和团队一起写作，实时看到他们的光标

✍️ 在编辑器里写欢迎、确认和最后机会邮件

posts.text: Today’s reminder that running a company is now voice notes and inference https://t.co/DUY43IjJea
posts.text_zh: 今日提醒：如今经营一家公司，就是语音备忘 + 模型推理。
posts.quoted_summary_zh: 引用的是他本人昨天的爆款长文（47 万浏览、1.2 万书签）：团队 50+ 人分布 12 国，但他和 agents 说话比和人类同事还多，详细列出从想法、设计、开发、用户测试、修 bug、数据分析到 agent 工具与 skills 的整套 AI 工作流，结尾一句「running a company is now voice notes and inference」。
